title: Amal se apne
body:
Amal se apne
kare nabi o ali ki midhat kaha kisi kam nasal ki kismat
<<DIVIDER>>
jo unki azmat ko jante hai wahi to gunn unke gaa rahe hai
jo apne qirdar me mujahir the sibte jafar ali k naukar
<<DIVIDER>>
isiliye darjaye shahadat imam unko dila rahe hai
jo paak teenat hai asal apni, amanse apne ata rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
welaki mehfil saja rahe hai, safe azaa ki bichha rahe hai
kare nabiyo ali ki midhat kaha kisi kam nasal ki kismat
<<DIVIDER>>
jo unke azamat ko jaante hai wahi to gun unke gaa rahe hai
jo unke garde safar bane the jo unke kadmo se mass hue the
<<DIVIDER>>
wo saare zarre sitare ban banke arsh pe jagmaga rahe hai
zahur ki thi jinhe tammanna safe wo apni durus karne hamesha jinko pukarte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo aane wale the aarahe hai saji hai mehfil jo arshe aula pe sayyade zain aabidi ki
to sibte jaffar ko sab malayk paynedawat bula rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo apne qirdar me mujahid the sibte jaffar ali k naukar     2
isilye darjaye shahadat imam unko dila rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
teri judai ka ghum hai lekin teri hi talkin k mutabik
teri hi khatir basad mussarrat teri shahadat mana rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo unke katil samajh rahe the k silsila khatm ho chuka hai
ab unke bete ko dekhkar wo baranjo tilmila rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo puchha maula ne sibte jafar hamare khatir hai koi tohfa
adab se do zaanu baith kar wo ali ko basta dikha rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lahad me aaye jo sibte jafar to bole munkir nakir baham
sawal chhodo nikalo basta lahad me ustad aarahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ibne ahmed the sibte jafar to ye abuzar hai ibne jafar     2
isi tarha silsila mawaddat ka aale ahmed chala rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo paak kinat hai asl apni aman se apne bata rahe hai
wila ki mehfil saja rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
safe azaa ki bichha rahe hai
jo paak kinat hai asl apni
